name: EMA33 Breakout Trailing Stop - XAUUSD M5
description: Long-only M5 breakout: enter when a bar closes above EMA(33); initial SL anchored per sl_mode with an ATR minimum-distance floor; TRUE partial close (ctx.close fraction) at 1R; runner keeps original SL with strategy-managed breakeven exit (bar close <= entry) and take-profit at runner_target_r * R.
sell_condition: Initial SL (engine, intrabar); after 1R partial: breakeven exit on bar close <= entry, or runner target at entry + runner_target_r * R
tp_sl_strategy: SL = min(sl_mode anchor, entry - min_stop_atr_mult*ATR); partial_fraction closed at +1R; runner TP at +runner_target_r R (bar-checked, next-open fill)
risk_management: risk_pct% equity risk per trade via size_for_risk; 20x leverage cap
notes: Converted 2026-07-07 from close-and-re-enter runner emulation to a true engine partial close. Engine cannot move SL/TP post-entry: runner breakeven/target are bar-close checks filled at next open; initial SL remains the intrabar backstop.
